faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Central Agricultural University Imphal (CAU) for its College of Agriculture located in Kyrdemkulai, Meghalaya, offering a temporary research position for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Senior Research Fellow (SRF) under the Central Agricultural University Imphal recruitment drive with Advertisement Number ICAR-NIAP/CAU/CoA-K/2026-27/1227.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position under this employment notification issued by Central Agricultural University Imphal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the SRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a graduate in Agriculture along with an M.Sc degree in Agricultural Economics, Agricultural Extension, or Agri-Business Management to be eligible to apply for this position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as applicable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for CAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly through email. Candidates are required to send their filled application form and required documents to the designated email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email for the Central Agricultural University Imphal Senior Research Fellow recruitment is 10th October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview scheduled for shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The interview for the eligible candidates who apply for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post is scheduled to be held on 12th October 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee details have been specified in the official notification released by Central Agricultural University Imphal for this temporary research fellowship position.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this job opening?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position will be carried out entirely based on their performance and credentials evaluated during the interview process.
